name: SX Beyond
storyline:
In the waning decades of the 21st century, humanity reached its technological zenith, forging a hyper-connected cyberpunk civilization powered by experimental quantum networks and advanced cybernetics. But progress outpaced wisdom. When a clandestine research initiative breached the dimensional veil during a classified energy experiment, it tore the sky open and invited an ancient, incomprehensible horrorscape into the heart of the world.

Sprawling neon metropolises fell overnight, transformed into twisted slaughterhouses overrun by infernal entities, biomechanical abominations, and the corrupted remnants of a shattered society. Within hours, the pillars of modern civilization collapsed under the weight of a demonic onslaught.

You were part of an elite squad en route to clear a hostile sector when your transport carrier malfunctioned and crash-landed in an uncharted, desolate region of the ruined earth. Cut off from command and surrounded by the scorched wreckage of your ship, your primary objective shifts from a routine deployment to raw survival. As you scavenge for vital components to repair your vessel and fight your way through the darkness, you begin stumbling upon encrypted logs, abandoned research terminals, and gruesome ritual sites left behind by the vanguard forces—uncovering the chilling truth of how the invasion began and what truly happened to your squadmates.
summary: SX Beyond is a visceral Survival Horror FPS set in a harrowing post-apocalyptic cyberpunk future. In a world where advanced technology has collapsed under the weight of a demonic invasion, your only option is to adapt, manage every resource, and fight to survive.
